Method of Attack: Malicious Chrome extensions containing hidden spyware code
Scraping user data from Facebook's site and users' web browsers without authorization
Installing malicious code in the background after installation on users' computers
Attack Vector: Malicious browser extensions installed by users from Chrome Web Store
Indicators of Compromise: Extensions available in Google's Chrome Web Store with more than 54,000 users
Scraped Facebook account information including name, user ID, gender, relationship status, and age group
